title: Preserve authored beam groups and stem overrides
scope: Retain GPIF beam XProperties, custom master-bar grouping and stem directions alongside existing binary display fields.
acceptance: Use force-merge, force-split, secondary-beam split and inverted/up/down stem variants independently.
Preserve a non-default custom grouping and exact ownership without deriving it solely from meter.
GP8/AlphaTab retains representable overrides; incompatible legacy-only display fields get individual dispositions.
exclusions: Do not infer custom beaming groups from meter or layout defaults when the exact master bar has no authored rule.
Keep legacy Beat.Display tuplet bracket, secondary-tuplet break, and force-bracket output outside the canonical beam/stem contract; GP8 reports each non-default field separately.
GPIF grace-beat stem direction remains with the separately scoped grace representation because those source occurrences project to GraceEffect rather than the public Beat type.
Do not add playback, rendering, or unrelated meter/layout behavior.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Imports GP5 following-beat connection flags into the previous beat's canonical mode and preserves explicit up/down direction independently.
Audits, parses, validates, and serializes exact GPIF beaming groups, beat XProperties, stem orientation, and field-specific legacy dispositions.
Carries master-bar and beat XProperties plus both GPIF stem-orientation elements.
Reports every incompatible legacy Beat.Display field separately during GP8 export.

Covers real GP5 and GP7 import, all sequential primary/secondary XProperty precedence cases, two adjacent same-meter headers with one exact owner, every canonical mode, invert-only plus independent up/down fields, exact wire output, strict preservation, and GP8 reimport.
Covers malformed GPIF values, strict diagnostics, and invalid public model rejection.
Proves known beaming and brush-duration IDs remain accepted while future beat/master-bar XProperties retain strict unknown-syntax diagnostics.
Covers minimum and maximum supported denominators, group counts, and group values through GP8 reimport.

Pinned AlphaTab proves all ordered XProperty precedence cases, invert-only output without a preferred direction, source and edited output, and adjacent-master-bar ownership for custom groups and every representable beat override.

Checked force merge/split/secondary split, invert/up/down direction, explicit custom groups, source-order precedence, GP5 adjacent-flag reconciliation, bounds, and exact consumer overrides. Legacy compatibility display fields retain separate reports; grace-occurrence stem projections remain outside the authored Beat slice.

resolution: Added exact master-bar BeamingRules and independent Beat.BeamingMode, InvertBeamDirection, and PreferredBeamDirection authorities. GP5 following-beat flags now populate the canonical previous-beat connection while raw Beat.Display fields remain compatible; GPIF parsing applies primary and secondary properties in pinned source order and audits duration/group bounds, padding, gaps, XProperty values, and stem tokens. Generic XProperty containers remain audit-closed: known beaming and brush-duration IDs are accepted, malformed or orphan brush timing receives its scoped invalid-data diagnostic, and future beat/master-bar IDs retain stable strict unknown-syntax diagnostics. GP8 writes exact groups, modes, inversion, and both stem-orientation elements, and reports each non-default legacy-only field separately. Focused real-fixture, all ordered-property, invert-only, two-adjacent-header ownership, malformed, numeric-boundary, wire, reimport, strict-preservation, audit-closure, and pinned AlphaTab tests cover the ticket without deriving layout or meter behavior.
